segments.name: Polyurethanes
segments.description: Manufactures and markets MDI, polyols and TPU polyurethane chemicals used in foams, coatings, adhesives, sealants and elastomers for industrial and building product manufacturers.
segments.evidence: We are a leading global manufacturer and marketer of a broad range of polyurethane chemicals, including MDI products, polyols and TPU

segments.name: Performance Products
segments.description: Makes amines and maleic anhydride intermediate chemicals for foam, fuel and lubricant additives, coatings, composites and construction materials sold to industrial manufacturers.
segments.evidence: Amines are a family of intermediate chemicals that are valued for their properties as a reactive agent, emulsifier, dispersant, detergent, solvent or corrosion inhibitor.

segments.name: Advanced Materials
segments.description: Supplies epoxy, acrylic and polyurethane polymer formulations, thermoset resins and additives to formulators serving aerospace, automotive, electronics and construction applications.
segments.evidence: Technologically- advanced epoxy, phenoxy, acrylic, polyurethane and acrylonitrile-butadiene-based polymer formulations

revenueModel.text: Industrial and building product manufacturers worldwide pay for diversified organic chemical products used in adhesives, aerospace, automotive, coatings, construction, electronics and insulation applications.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products comprise many different chemicals and chemical formulations, which we market globally to a wide range of consumers that consist primarily of industrial and building product manufacturers.

changes.text: In 2023 the company completed the sale of its textile chemicals and dyes business to Archroma.
changes.evidence: On February 28, 2023, we completed the sale of our textile chemicals and dyes business ("Textile Effects Business") to Archroma, a portfolio company of SK Capital Partners ("Archroma").
